_about: A fixed-grip chair's stop gate at its top return terminal (task 4.50 phase 4; bldgkit/stop_gate.py builds it; owner 2026-11-24: copy the real ones from the photo survey). A slim white post on the ramp past the unload, on the lift's centreline, and a thin dark bar (1 in square) from its top along the lift line out under the chair turning round the far side of the wheel, below the seat, with a proximity switch at the pivot. One model per terminal style (`variants`), each for every chair width: unload_ramp.gate_at places it, and the post stands well inside the circle the turning chairs' inner ends sweep (unloadramp.json `gate.postClear`); pick() sets the post's depth to the ramp's surface under it (for the deepest chair width; `post.buryMax` the most another width may bury its foot). `bar.height` is unloadramp.json's gate: 250 mm under the chair's lowest point. No sign (owner, 2026-11-24). Our own design: no maker's name or mark on it. Millimetres.
